description: Search across the entire VisioForge SDK API — class names, method names, property names, event names, and their documentation text. Returns ranked results. Use this when you don't know the exact class name, or to find all classes related to a concept (e.g., 'RTSP streaming', 'video overlay', 'audio capture').

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 20, max: 50)

query.description: Search query — can be a class name, method name, concept, or description (e.g., 'RTSP', 'video resize', 'audio equalizer', 'H264 encoder settings')

name: search_api
